source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (Gemini Developer API, the backend Firebase AI Logic's GoogleAIBackend bills through)
tier: Paid tier, Standard (non-batch), USD per 1M tokens, text/image input
notes: Cost is computed only from token counts the pipeline reports (Firebase AI Logic response usageMetadata: promptTokenCount, candidatesTokenCount + thoughtsTokenCount). The harness never guesses tokens.
Output price includes thinking tokens, so pipelines must add thoughtsTokenCount into outputTokens.
On-device Gemini Nano (Chrome Prompt API) has no per-call API charge; the device's compute and battery are not costed.
Free tier is ignored: it has rate limits and Google may use free-tier data to improve its products, which rules it out for medical documents.
gemini-2.5-flash is deprecated; from 2026-12-01 its requests route to gemini-3.5-flash-lite and bill at that rate (per the same page).
If the pipeline uses the Vertex AI backend instead, replace these rates with Vertex AI pricing (https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/pricing).
